proposal.observation: Round-1 feedback: the theta crop removed ~316 of 3123 rows (190 px at the top, 126 px at the bottom; map now ~2417x2798 px) and K_height/angle put the SAM K band at 1280-1442 px against measured oblique K edges at 1277/1445 px (centre 1361 = prompt y). correspondence_f1@15 rose 0.467->0.618, boundary_explained_edge@25 0.55->0.94 and chamfer 66->31 px, because the previously unlabeled, hole-fragmented end bands (top 121 px, bottom 90 px) were the main source of unexplained edges. The whole map is now labeled except a 24 px sliver at the bottom; the A1 block is truncated by the top edge (its A1/A2 boundary is at 609 px with a 671 px AB stack, so ~62 px of A1 lie above the map). sam_fill_rate fell 0.649->0.586, i.e. by 9.7%, almost exactly the 10.1% row loss, while denoise_retained_ratio fell 0.695->0.633: fill tracks the retained point fraction, not the labeled fraction of the map (labeled/retained stays ~0.93 in both rounds). Remaining NaN (0.098) is physical occlusion: the sidewall cable-bracket rows at 98-298 px (52% NaN) and 2476-2675 px (38%), the crown cable tray inside K (1321-1341 px), and the walkway structure in the bottom-right; SAM masks already outline these holes, so those hole rims count as explained edges. Ring joints (K-edge resets) sit exactly on 10 equal pitches of the map width: 241.7 px = ~1209 mm at 5 mm/px, and the SAM ring bands are anchored there. A/B horizontal boundaries (609, 2113) sit 9-13 px from the detected horizontal joint rows (~600, ~2100), inside the 15 px tolerance; the K edges, taper and ring pitch are all matched, so template geometry has no remaining bounded lever except segment_width.
proposal.rule: d12 (m_coverage low) read through the round-1 response: coverage is bounded by stage-2 retention, so r_balance_coverage means recovering retained rows only where stage-5 will label them and where hole density is at or below the map average; r_fix_template for segment_width so ring bands close on the measured pitch. Stage-1 remains locked (residual 3.2 cm); detection is unchanged (10/10 rings, propagated), so no detecting change; no radial-gate widening because filling occluder holes would remove the hole-rim boundaries that currently explain edges and would compress the depth-map contrast SAM depends on.
proposal.failure_mode: stage_5_segmentation.f_over_under_coverage (under-coverage driven by the round-1 stage-2 theta crop truncating the A1 block at the low-theta map edge), with a minor stage_5_segmentation.f_template_mismatch on ring width.
proposal.rationale: Give back 0.3 m of the round-1 crop at the low-theta end only (mask_theta_low 2.5->2.2, ~60 rows). Under the pipeline's row = (theta - theta_low)/resolution mapping this is the top of the map, where the restored rows fall inside the already-truncated A1 block (62 px of A1 are currently cut off), so they are labeled rather than left as an unlabeled sliver, and their NaN density (~10%) is at the map average; expected fill gain ~ +0.012 with F1 and nan neutral, plus a slightly taller map giving the vertical Hough more votes. The high-theta end is left at 16.5 because the rows there would belong to a new B1 block sliver that the reverse/stop logic does not segment (that is why round 0 had a 90 px unlabeled band) and were 45-50% NaN, so restoring them would repeat the round-0 unexplained-edge failure. segment_width is set to the measured ring pitch (1209 mm) so consecutive ring bands meet at the K-edge resets without a gap; this is a no-op if the reference already equals it. K_height and angle stay at the round-1 measured values; everything else is untouched to protect the F1 gain, which the round-1 deltas show is the dominant proxy term.
